reviewer: Grok (Mini, 2026-09-19): clause-by-clause vs locked PG 12 Khazarzar Greek; Psalms 1–2 tip; lemma-led scaffold discarded

scope_review.notes: Tip of Origen Greek psalm-catena, Psalms 1–2. PG 12 via Khazarzar. Not the Rufinus homilies on Psalms 36–38. Remaining psalms held. Inline Scripture as the lock quotes it.

reviews.notes: Psalm 1:1–2. Blessing is not mere abstinence (common to beasts) but will in the evangelical law. Ladder: first step is withdrawal from evil (Psalm 34:14). Easier commands vs athlete deeds (Exodus 20:14; Matthew 5:41, 19:21; Leviticus 19:18). Way of sinners = devil (James 4:7); I am the way (John 14:6). Scaffold discarded. OCR spacing restored where the word is clear.

Psalm 1:3. Tree = Christ. Aquila transplanted, rooted in the patriarchs; or the Savior's soul into paradise (Luke 23:43). Outlets of waters = scriptures. Fruit = right faith; leaves = commandments, or humility. Scaffold discarded.

Psalm 1:4–6. Some double οὐχ οὕτως; Hebrew and translators do not. Rise into judgment, not into questioning. γινώσκει = honors (Exodus 33:17; 2 Timothy 2:19). Heretics who annihilate substances corrected: the way perishes, the persons remain. Scaffold discarded.
Psalm 2 hypothesis (2.π). First psalm as inscription of the second. σήμερον is a part of time; Son always from the Father. Lock brackets unrestored. Scaffold not globbed.

Psalm 2:3–5. Burst bonds / throw off yoke: nations not free; Christ to angels or Father and Spirit or apostles. Letter that kills vs spiritual law. Heaven laughs at earthly-minded kings. Net = Matthew 13:47. Anger speaks (Nineveh), does not always chastise.
Psalm 2:7, 2.8, 2.12 as printed (no 2.9–2.11 in this block). Today always being called. Devil showed kingdoms. παιδεία = training, measured-suffering of passions from the practical life.
